notes.title: Abyss Crew official release
notes.notes:
After 10 years of development and 5 years of Early Access, we are pleased to finally announce:
[b]ABYSS CREW WILL OFFICIALLY RELEASE MONDAY, MARCH 31., 2025![/b]
There will be many new features, a better tutorial, new levels, improved graphics, bug fixes, a more stable network...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32130619/25ffa9047b78f0ecc11be7a0e327b5cdf8f0500b.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 2.19a - last before release
notes.notes:
[b]Dev v2.19 - 04/03/2025[/b]
[i]Steam version has been updated this morning with version 2.19, the last before the final relase[/i]

* Major bugfix :
-regular crash because of far instances were deactivated but not reactivated once close. The game will require slightly more memory though.

* Graphics/UI/UX:
-remove background UI
-increase ambient light
-ink splash should be dark gray and not black
-slightly zoom/dezoom depending on sub speed
-hide unaccessible high speeds
-Sonar: radar map scanning should display percentage
-added list players and current station (pilot, bridge, etc)
-UI: topleft tooltips should be only in the bottom right of the screen
-UI: topleft tooltips should open from the bottom right and not topleft

* Level:
-exit obstacles of c1l1 are too small
-add more repair kits
-Intro level: better indicate circle exit

* Menu:
-Connexion screen: add "server should be displayed in less than 1 minute"
-Menu: added small message about Discord server
-server list buttons are now not clickable if no server is found

* Bug fix:
-shark and megalodon make no damage; remove collision
-fixed "Portuges" instead of "English"
-ambient light are buggy when diving down
-Engineer modules tooltips are mixed
-help buttons don't blend in spectator mode
-tooltip highlights even when not hovered by mouse

Attached:
New station UI without background

notes.title: Release of Abyss Crew version 2
notes.notes:
-- Greetings, crewmembers,

[b]Today we are pleased to announce the release of a very important update for the game, "Abyss Crew v2".[/b]

We are sure that if you were already interested in Abyss Crew, you will enjoy this new version! It involved 4 years of internal development, with - we know...- not much communication about it. The list of changes is large, you can have a tour of the changes [url=http://abysscrew.com/index.php/2023/12/13/abyss-crew-v2/]on the game website[/url]

[b]Moreover, the game is part of the “Made in Quebec”  celebration week, with a 50% off promotion until Sunday 4th February![/b]

Remember: you can buy a key to host a game, and invite your friends to play with you for free with the “Friend Pass” available on Steam!

[i]Note: this is precisely version 2.16f. Future updates will include translations of the game (French, Spanish, German, Russian, Portuguese are planed), a better tutorial to learn how the submarine works, and new levels with new bosses.[/i]

End of transmission,

Captain Pol, out --
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32130619/780a2ba227a5899fdf4335dadc811bbc0619c443.gif[/img]

notes.title: Abyss Crew Early Access release
notes.notes:
--Greetings, crewmembers,

Abyss Crew is releasing today in Early Access, Thursday 30. April 2020!
Thank you for your patience and your support.

Some tips:
[list]
[*]one key per player is needed for online play
[*]one key is enough for any number of players in local play. Players can download the special version which can join a local game at this address: [url=www.abysscrew.com/local-game]www.abysscrew.com/local-game[/url] (you can also find it on our Discord)
[*]if you are less than 4 players, missing stations are handled by bots
[/list]

If you want to give us some feedback, find a crew or just chat a little bit, join us on our Discord ([url=discord.abysscrew.com]discord.abysscrew.com[/url]).

It's time to embark into the abyss with your friends!

Captain Pol, out--
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32130619/780a2ba227a5899fdf4335dadc811bbc0619c443.gif[/img]

notes.title: Abyss Crew release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32130619/780a2ba227a5899fdf4335dadc811bbc0619c443.gif[/img]
-- Greetings, crewmembers,

Abyss Crew will be released in Early Access on 30. April 2020!

The game will cost 19.99 € / 21.99 US$ / 29.99 CAD$ during the early access duration, meaning a 33% discount compared to the final price (29.99 € / 32.99 US$ / 44.99 CAD$). You can also have a 4-players pack for the price of 3, i.e., 59.99 € / 65.99 US$ / 89.99 CAD$.
To play online, you will need [b]one key per player[/b]: each player runs the game from his own library.
To play locally, you will need [b]only one key[/b]: the owner runs the game, and the other players use a special "local client" of the game, which is free to download, to join a game. This special version cannot join online game or create a game, however.

[i]For those of you who have contributed to the Kickstarter, Steam keys will be sent about 10 days before the release, around April 20th, 2020. If you don't want a Steam key, but would rather have a stand-alone game instead, please message us as soon as possible.[/i]

For any question, send us an email to contact@abysscrew.com !

End of transmission,

Captain Pol, out --
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32130619/a9c744f008b7d094f58838f09f885d8ad1ef9907.png[/img]

notes.title: [Update] Version 0.94a
notes.notes:
-- Greetings, crewmembers,

The build version 0.94a has been released!

This version was focused on the level design:
-average level size has been decreased
-two new maps have been added
-a trigger system has been coded to include dynamic elements
-we conceived the first three game campaigns: Moby Squid, The Hunt for Red Octopus, and The Diving Dutchman. If you have ideas for cool campaigns, we're open to any suggestion! We got some great ideas already, thank you to the contributors!

Additional changes:
(network)    scanning of environment obj_object behaves strangely as a client
(gameplay)    reduce scrap quantity
(gameplay)    decreased scanning time
(gameplay)    decreased standard torpedo loading time
(gameplay)    remove lockable target (for gunner)
(graphics)    improved bubbles appearance on menu and bridge
(network)    on clients, start game button should light only when a game has been started
(gameplay)    players should receive incoming calls/transmissions
(menu)    options: remap keys
(graphics)    differentiate left locked/right locked on gunner screen

The version can be found in the releases section of the Discord server for those who have access to the game.
[i]/!\ Identified bug /! \ The map "Hunt for Red Octopus" cannot be finished, as there is no exit in the level. This bug has been fixed in the future version 0.95.
[/i]
Captain Pol, out --
